summary.en-US: Keep one Firefox network identity consistent: proxy, public IP, approximate location, timezone, and WebRTC.

version.approval_notes: Reviewer notes are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. The extension is Firefox-only. Proxy passwords stay in storage.session. A fresh install exposes virtual Direct but does not activate it or contact a GeoIP service. Direct routing works before optional GeoIP consent. Schema 2 migrates version-1 profiles. The local coordinate picker sends no tile requests and works offline. Do not treat an unsigned GitHub zip as the user installer.
